pencereler.5-12: sixth, 1917. Halifax Harbour, Canada. A cargo ship packed with wartime explosives collides with another vessel. A fire starts
pencereler.12-20: on deck, and crowds gather at their windows to watch. Then the ship detonates with the force of three kilotons of TNT.

segmentler.metin: The Halifax Explosion flattened a square mile of the city.
It took only a collision between two ships.
So how could a collision between two ships do this?
The answer is detonation of a burning munitions cargo — and it is why munitions shipping rules and port emergency planning changed.
